flash_plan.note: Layout check only; it lists all five images but this package writes the application alone.

flash.command: python -m esptool --chip esp32p4 --port COM7 --baud 460800 --before default-reset --after hard-reset write-flash --flash-mode dio --flash-size 32MB --flash-freq 40m 0x200000 E:/v6/s1/build/xiaozhi.bin
flash.scope: application only at 0x200000; no other image, no partition change, no NVS erase, no C5/eFuse/security change, no recovery write-back

device_binary_binding.method: read_flash 0x200000 0x2E8FF0 (length computed from the manifest, read-only) compared byte-for-byte with the candidate build

network_sequence_first_60s: WifiStation: No AP on saved channels, starting full scan
boot_capture.note: The device is not flashed with a saved AP that is on the air, so this boot is expected to exercise the connect/backoff path rather than association. That is CP2's subject, not a CP1 result.

limitations: Verifies the write landed and the candidate boots; it says nothing about behaviour under the network or audio scenarios.
Only the application partition was written; the other four images are identical to candidate 07 and were not re-flashed.
The runtime prints a 9-hex-digit ELF prefix; full-hash binding comes from the read-only readback.
